    # Horizontal beam at y=1.0 to intercept falling boulders close to core level
    horizontal_beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=10.0, y=1.0, width=7.4, height=0.4, density=10.0)
    
    # Add multiple vertical columns to distribute forces across many joints
    num_columns = 10
    for i in range(num_columns):
        x_col = 6.3 + i * (7.4 / (num_columns - 1))  # Evenly spaced along horizontal beam
        # Vertical columns with increased width for better force distribution
        col = sandbox.add_beam(x=x_col, y=0.5, width=1.0, height=1.0, density=5.0)
        # Connect to horizontal beam at its top surface (y=1.0) and ground at y=0.0
        sandbox.add_joint(horizontal_beam, col, (x_col, 1.0), type='rigid')
        sandbox.add_joint(col, None, (x_col, 0.0), type='rigid')
    
    return horizontal_beam
